text.en: Most pet owners praise Dr Cua, Dr Lee, and clinic nurses for their thoughtful consultations and warm demeanour. Clients highlight that practitioners remember individual patient histories and explain medical findings with patience. Whilst one reviewer experienced a misdiagnosis during an urgent visit, the general consensus reflects dependable clinical staff.

title.en: Gentle handling for feline and canine patients

text.en: Reviewers emphasize the compassionate care shown to cats and dogs during exams and dental cleanings. Clients appreciate that staff permit owners to stay alongside anxious pets to provide reassurance throughout treatments. Pet owners report that their animals feel relaxed and supported during routine examinations and medical follow-ups.

Many clients value thorough discussions regarding diagnostic options, treatment fees, and preventative measures. Pet owners also appreciate the presence of Korean-speaking staff, which assists non-native English speakers in describing pet symptoms. However, one owner reported unacceptable clinical advice when a swelling was misidentified.

q.en: Can owners remain with anxious pets during examinations?

a.en: Yes, clients appreciate that staff permit owners to stay beside nervous animals during consultations and treatments.

q.en: Is language support available for non-native English speakers?

a.en: Reviewers note that Korean-speaking team members are available to assist clients with medical discussions.

q.en: Does the practice provide dental cleaning procedures?

a.en: Yes, pet owners report successful dental cleanings performed under general anaesthesia.

q.en: How are consultation fees and treatment options explained?

a.en: Clients report that clinicians review treatment estimates and price breakdowns prior to proceeding.
